summary: Implement constructable Proxy [[Construct]] via construct trap, forwarding newTarget and requiring an Object result.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.precondition: proxy has [[Construct]] only because target is a constructor
semantics.missing: absent trap performs Construct(target, argumentsList, newTarget)
semantics.result: trap result must be Object or TypeError

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: newTarget forwarded
tests.input: function F(){};let seen;const P=new Proxy(F,{construct(t,args,n){seen=n;return {ok:true}}});const o=new P();console.log(o.ok,seen===P);

tests.name: primitive construct result throws
tests.input: function F(){};const P=new Proxy(F,{construct(){return 1}});try{new P()}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
